roles.strategist: Researches the market and issues trade signals (ticker, size, stop, rationale)
roles.risk: Automatically reviews every signal against RULES.md: approve or reject
roles.trader: Executes risk-approved orders (incl. stops) and records every fill
roles.data: Bookkeeping, reconciliation, watches equity and drawdown, publishes the daily report and double-up progress
roles.warroom: Signal review room: the Strategist proposes, the Risk Officer stamps
roles.hub: Building that represents the exchange (this page is read-only and not connected to any exchange)
roles.rumor: Watches market chatter on X, updated 6 times a day (rumors are leads, not trade signals)

dataPipeline: Refreshed every 30 min by a scheduled script on the Mac (read-only snapshot + public prices, no AI); fills/signals update after the team syncs its logs
